comment: Written from the maker's own source at commit 3a9441f, "v 2.3.4 buxfix mpe volume", which is the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.3.4 and is also the head of the repository, together with manuals/README.md in the same tree and a render of every panel. No module in this plugin has a plugin-wide menu; BaseModuleWidget::appendContextMenu adds only a separator and then each module's own items. Every trigger input in the plugin goes through rescaleInput in src/util/Switches.cpp, which is rescale(v, 0.1, 2, 0, 1), so a Schmitt trigger that counts high above 2V and low below 0.1V. Five controls across the plugin were proved dead by reading every use of their parameter and are given lines saying so: the Tape Recorder's Motor Power screw, and the Tape Recorder Mixer's Tape Ducking knob, Ducking input, Erase input, Solo switch and Delay in samples screw. Tracker and MIDI Controller are both unfinished, and More Fun with Frames is a line-for-line copy of Fun with Frames.
